title: FlexLine Late Fee and the Balance Before the Fee
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the late fee is scaled by a balance-tier share.

**Clause.** The balance-tier share follows the line's balance before the fee, its ledger entries added up (charges less payments and waivers): below 500.00 USD gives 0.60; 500.00 USD or more but below 3000.00 USD gives 0.80; 3000.00 USD or more gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the late fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the unpaid part of the minimum payment and rounded to the cent.

**The balance before the fee** adds up every ledger entry on the line before the fee being booked: draws, draw fees, interest charges, annual fees, returned payments, late fees and returned-payment fees, less payments and fee waivers.

| Balance before the fee | Share |
|---|---|
| below 500.00 | 0.60 |
| 500.00 to 2999.99 | 0.80 |
| 3000.00 or more | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical ledger:* draws of 2500.00, draw fees of 50.00 and interest of 100.00, less payments of 400.00 and no waivers, give 2250.00 USD, so the share is 0.80. A balance of exactly 500.00 gives 0.80 and exactly 3000.00 gives 1.00.
